inputs.text: Are you still checking that three-way match in Excel by hand, or does someone pull it automatically?
[flatly] By hand. And per period, not per supplier. So across locations, nobody sees a thing.
[smoothly] Let the other entity invoice for the extra part. Administratively simpler for everyone.
Next month a different location, please. Not Culemborg twice in a row.
Residual risk twenty-one point two five. The highest in the entire matrix. There is no control that adds up invoices per supplier.
Friday, the third of April. An outage.
The I-A-M connection is playing up again. Access is going through the old Excel file today.
[sighs] ChangeFlow is down as well, tickets will follow later. We know what we did anyway.
Is the approval log for the journal entries still there? I didn't see it in the export.
[dryly] The logs are switched on, sure. It's just that nobody ever looks at them. Classic.
[amused] I-A-M is down, access just runs through the little spreadsheet now. Handy, actually.
At this moment two risks tip from medium to high, without a single amount having moved. The framework cannot tell an outage apart from intent.
[quietly] Nobody here really looks at who approves something. Only at whether it adds up.
